subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “It was a network of shops, rules, washing, and trust.”?
options: Sometimes the best answer depends on time, purpose, and compromise.
It is affected by design, habits, stress, and social pressure.
Sustainability depends on design as much as desire.
When too much enters it, the whole balance changes.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「It was a network of shops, rules, washing, and trust. Sustainability depends on design as much as desire.」，答案為「Sustainability depends on design as much as desire.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Sustainability depends on design as much as desire.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
